patch.value: Resolve conflicts and propagate resolutions through automatic descendant rebase

Extend explicit tip resolution to selected ancestor changes and automatically replay every descendant with stable change ids and FileIds. Tip resolution is included in the first slice; ancestor propagation follows here.

resolve supports path, field and ours/theirs/base/value; ancestor resolution replays descendants across branches/tags atomically; unrelated edits survive and stable change ids persist; new conflicts remain recorded with complete sides and verification passes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Deferred scope: resolve an ancestor change and automatically rebase all descendants while preserving stable change ids, file identities, unrelated edits and unresolved alternatives. Include repeated and overlapping disagreements in conflict-aware replay, across sibling branches and tags. The first slice resolves at HEAD only and does not claim propagation.
